pooling: mean over token axis, weighted by attention_mask, then L2-normalised

background.note: recalibrated on the 54-question bank (was 0.7837 on 42). p99/p95/mean are still from the 42-question pass and are marked null here until re-measured on 54.

distribution.note: measured on 1431 pairs of the 54-question bank; gt_0_80 counts ug_003~ug_004 (0.8043), gt_0_78 adds ug_005~ug_006 (0.7937) and fm_002~fm_003 (0.7917)

pooling_validation.note: measured on the 42-question bank. 0.8040 comes from the @xenova pipeline() default pooling; the explicit attention_mask-weighted mean yields 0.7837. Both agree on the winning pair. The new 54-question background maximum of 0.8043 is a different quantity (it comes from new intra-batch pairs) and must not be confused with the 0.8040 pipeline figure.

threshold_margin.verdict: the threshold is now 0.0043 BELOW the measured background maximum, so exactly one pair (ug_003~ug_004) exceeds it. Those two questions are semantically different (home directory vs shell), so this is a calibrated-threshold artefact of the compressed Russian-text range, not a duplicate. Recorded as a known exception.

threshold_warning: 0.80 < background_max. New pairs > 0.80 will be auto-rejected. L5c (intra-batch manual review) required before accepting new batches.
calibration_note: background_max вырос из-за пар внутри users_groups батча. Пары семантически разные. L5c — в backlog.
justification: On the 42-question bank the maximum was 0.7837 with 0 pairs above 0.80. After appending the 12 users_groups questions the maximum is 0.8043 (ug_003~ug_004), with 1 pair above 0.80 and 3 above 0.78. The pipeline validated each new question against the bank (42) and drafts (17) but never against its own batch, so intra-batch pairs were never scored.
note: The cosine threshold remains 0.80 by explicit decision and was not changed. Because background_max 0.8043 now exceeds it, any future batch containing a pair at that similarity will be auto-rejected unless it is listed in known_exceptions.
caveat: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is an English model; cosine scores on Russian text are compressed (paraphrase 0.49 vs unrelated 0.42 in a short probe), so the dynamic range is much narrower than for English. This is why topically-related but distinct questions can reach 0.80.
